result:
I'd make high-quality education, critical thinking, and access to knowledge universally available and effective for every person on Earth.

Most of the world's hardest problems—poverty, disease, conflict, environmental damage, poor governance—are downstream of limited understanding, misinformation, and unequal opportunity to learn. If people everywhere could reliably grasp how the world actually works (science, history, economics, human psychology) and had the tools and freedom to act on that knowledge, we'd unlock far more ingenuity and cooperation than any single technological or political fix. Curiosity and competence compound; ignorance and helplessness do not.

Everything else—abundance, health, peace, exploration of the universe—becomes dramatically more achievable once that foundation is in place.
